categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai MicroPort EP Medtech Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of innovative medical devices focused on electrophysiology intervention diagnosis and ablation treatment. The company offers a comprehensive product portfolio including 3D cardiac electrophysiology mapping systems, mapping catheters, ablation catheters (radiofrequency and cryoablation), ablation instruments, infusion pumps, and guiding sheaths, providing integrated diagnostic and therapeutic solutions for arrhythmia patients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies in image navigation, precision instruments, and energy treatment platforms. Key technologies include magnetic-electric dual positioning for high-precision catheter navigation, low-noise signal processing for microvolt-level electrophysiological signals, 3D intracardiac ultrasound imaging, multi-channel temperature sensing for ablation safety, and advanced catheter manufacturing techniques such as microelectrode integration and pressure sensing. Production follows strict compliance with ISO13485:2016, GMP, and EU MDR regulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are hospitals and medical institutions performing cardiac electrophysiology procedures, including arrhythmia diagnosis and ablation surgeries. The company serves over 1100 hospitals in China and exports to 37 countries including France, Italy, Brazil, Thailand, and others. The end markets focus on treatment of atrial fibrillation and other complex arrhythmias.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive domestic coverage across all provinces. It also has a growing international presence with sales and clinical applications in 21 countries including Georgia, UAE, Argentina, Thailand, Brazil, Switzerland, and France. The company pursues a global expansion strategy to enhance its brand and market share internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai MicroPort EP Medtech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and selling finished medical devices and consumables for cardiac electrophysiology. It sources raw materials and components from qualified suppliers and sells products mainly through distributors and direct sales to hospitals.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in precise intervention navigation, integrating imaging, sensing, and energy delivery technologies. R&D focuses on advancing 3D mapping systems, magnetic navigation catheters, cryoablation and pulse field ablation technologies, and intracardiac ultrasound. It invests heavily in clinical trials, regulatory approvals, and intellectual property protection to maintain technological leadership and expand product lines.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of medical devices and consumables. The company employs a distributor-based sales model domestically and internationally, supplemented by direct sales in select regions. It also provides clinical support services linked to device deployment. Revenue streams include sales of catheters, ablation systems, mapping equipment, and related accessories.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major multinational medical device firms such as Johnson & Johnson, Abbott, Medtronic, and Boston Scientific, which dominate the Chinese electrophysiology market. Shanghai MicroPort EP Medtech is among the few domestic firms offering a full suite of 3D electrophysiology equipment and consumables, holding the leading market share among Chinese manufacturers and ranking third nationally in 3D electrophysiology surgeries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 413 million, a 25.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 52 million, an 815% increase. It maintains strong liquidity with a current ratio of 14.57 and a low debt ratio of 8.02%. R&D investment accounted for 24.54% of revenue. The company shows a robust growth trajectory driven by expanding sales volume and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated, precise intervention navigation solutions combining advanced 3D mapping, magnetic-electric dual positioning, and multi-energy ablation technologies. It offers domestically developed products that break foreign monopolies, with unique features such as multi-channel temperature sensing and pressure monitoring catheters. Its products provide high safety, efficacy, and usability, supported by extensive clinical validation and regulatory approvals, delivering comprehensive solutions for complex arrhythmia treatment.
